points: Yirmiyahu walks around wearing a yoke to show that Bavel will rule the region.
Chananyah ben Azur, who the Gemara in Sanhedrin says was a real navi, announces in Hashem's name that within two years the keilim and the exiles, including Yechanyah, will come back.
Yirmiyahu answers "Amen, I wish it were so," but it isn't Hashem's message. He hates having to give bad news.
Chananyah breaks Yirmiyahu's yoke in front of everyone, and Yirmiyahu just walks away. Knowing he's right and still not fighting back is maybe his most powerful lesson.
Hashem says the wooden yokes will become iron yokes, and Chananyah dies that same year. A cautionary tale: even a real navi needs huge self-awareness to know the message is truly from Hashem.
